end.summary: Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes and describing flat and curved faces using examples such as a glue stick, candle, roller and rocket. Aditya explained the rocket design clearly: a cylinder for the body and a cone for the tip, including two flat circular ends on a cylinder. They first called every box a cube, then corrected this by noticing that a long side can be rectangular; the mix-up about a shape’s name when turned was not corrected by the last example. At home, ask them to check whether all faces are equal squares before calling a box a cube, and turn objects around while naming the same solid.
